mapper.sql: SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.stock_code AS stockCode, c.dart_corp_code AS corpCode, r.business_year AS businessYear, r.report_code AS reportCode, r.fs_div AS fsDiv, r.receipt_no AS receiptNo, r.collected_at AS collectedAt FROM financial_report r JOIN company c ON c.stock_code = r.stock_code
mapper.select: SELECT account_code AS accountCode, account_name AS accountName, current_amount AS currentAmount, previous_amount AS previousAmount, currency, COALESCE(value_status, CASE WHEN current_amount IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END) AS valueStatus, source_account_id AS sourceAccountId, source_account_name AS sourceAccountName FROM financial_value WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company (stock_code, company_name, market_type, dart_corp_code) VALUES (#{stock}, #{name}, 'KOSPI', #{corp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE company_name = VALUES(company_name), dart_corp_code = VALUES(dart_corp_code)

INSERT INTO financial_report (stock_code, receipt_no, business_year, report_code, fs_div, collected_at) VALUES (#{report.stockCode}, #{report.receiptNo}, #{report.businessYear}, #{report.reportCode}, #{report.fsDiv}, #{collectedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE collected_at = VALUES(collected_at)

INSERT INTO financial_value (report_id, account_code, account_name, source_account_id, source_account_name, current_amount, previous_amount, currency, value_status) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{code}, #{metric.label}, #{metric.sourceAccountId}, #{metric.sourceAccountName}, #{metric.currentAmount}, #{metric.previousAmount}, #{metric.currency}, #{metric.status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_name = VALUES(account_name), source_account_id = VALUES(source_account_id), source_account_name = VALUES(source_account_name), current_amount = VALUES(current_amount), previous_amount = VALUES(previous_amount), currency = VALUES(currency), value_status = VALUES(value_status)
